name: cxj
description: Cold-open Java/Spring answers for coding agents: who calls what (typed, with certainty labels), HTTP endpoints, beans, config keys, dependency versions and their real APIs — from a fresh read of your source every time. No daemon, no embeddings, no on-disk index, so nothing can go stale. Requires the cxj binary (brew install umuterturk/tap/cxj, npm i -g @umutert/cxj, or a release asset).
